defmodule CIRunner.Pipeline do
  @moduledoc "CI/CD pipeline executor with connection pooling for build agents"

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @pool_size 10
  @allowed_stages ~w(compile test lint format dialyzer credo docs)
  @stage_modules %{
    "compile" => CIRunner.Stages.Compile,
    "test" => CIRunner.Stages.Test,
    "lint" => CIRunner.Stages.Lint,
    "format" => CIRunner.Stages.Format,
    "dialyzer" => CIRunner.Stages.Dialyzer,
    "credo" => CIRunner.Stages.Credo,
    "docs" => CIRunner.Stages.Docs
  }

  defstruct [:pool, :config, :build_id, :stages, :metadata]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    pool = :poolboy.start_link(
      [{:name, {:local, :agent_pool}},
       {:worker_module, CIRunner.AgentWorker},
       {:size, @pool_size},
       {:max_overflow, 2}]
    )
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{pool: pool, config: opts[:config], stages: []}}
  end

  def execute_pipeline(build_config) when is_map(build_config) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:execute, build_config})
  end

  def handle_call({:execute, build_config}, _from, state) do
    with {:ok, validated} <- validate_config(build_config),
         {:ok, stages} <- resolve_stages(validated),
         {:ok, result} <- run_stages(stages, state.pool) do
      {:reply, {:ok, result}, %{state | stages: stages}}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  defp validate_config(%{"stages" => stages, "project" => project} = config)
       when is_list(stages) and is_binary(project) do
    metadata = Map.get(config, "metadata", %{})
    hooks = Map.get(config, "hooks", %{})
    {:ok, %{stages: stages, project: project, metadata: metadata, hooks: hooks}}
  end
  defp validate_config(_), do: {:error, :invalid_config}

  defp resolve_stages(%{stages: stages, hooks: hooks} = validated) do
    resolved = Enum.reduce_while(stages, {:ok, []}, fn stage, {:ok, acc} ->
      case resolve_single_stage(stage, hooks) do
        {:ok, mod} -> {:cont, {:ok, acc ++ [mod]}}
        {:error, _} = err -> {:halt, err}
      end
    end)
    resolved
  end

  defp resolve_single_stage(stage_name, hooks) when is_binary(stage_name) do
    case Map.get(@stage_modules, stage_name) do
      nil -> {:error, {:unknown_stage, stage_name}}
      mod -> {:ok, {mod, Map.get(hooks, stage_name, %{})}}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_single_stage(%{"custom" => module_ref, "args" => args}, _hooks) do
    resolve_custom_stage(module_ref, args)
  end
  defp resolve_single_stage(_, _), do: {:error, :invalid_stage_format}

  defp resolve_custom_stage(module_ref, args) when is_binary(module_ref) do
    # Validate module reference follows naming convention
    if valid_module_namespace?(module_ref) do
      mod = String.to_existing_atom("Elixir." <> module_ref)
      if function_exported?(mod, :run, 2) do
        {:ok, {mod, args}}
      else
        {:error, {:missing_callback, module_ref}}
      end
    else
      {:error, {:invalid_namespace, module_ref}}
    end
  rescue
    ArgumentError -> {:error, {:module_not_found, module_ref}}
  end

  defp valid_module_namespace?(ref) do
    parts = String.split(ref, ".")
    length(parts) >= 2 and
      Enum.all?(parts, &String.match?(&1, ~r/^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$/)) and
      hd(parts) == "CIRunner"
  end

  defp run_stages(stages, pool) do
    results = Enum.reduce_while(stages, {:ok, []}, fn {mod, args}, {:ok, acc} ->
      worker = :poolboy.checkout(pool)
      try do
        case GenServer.call(worker, {:run_stage, mod, args}) do
          {:ok, result} -> {:cont, {:ok, acc ++ [result]}}
          {:error, _} = err -> {:halt, err}
        end
      after
        :poolboy.checkin(pool, worker)
      end
    end)
    results
  end
end

defmodule CIRunner.PluginLoader do
  @moduledoc "Handles dynamic loading of pipeline plugins from trusted registries"

  @registry_url "https://plugins.internal.ci/api/v1"

  def load_plugin(plugin_spec) when is_map(plugin_spec) do
    with {:ok, manifest} <- fetch_manifest(plugin_spec),
         :ok <- verify_signature(manifest),
         {:ok, module_name} <- extract_module(manifest) do
      register_module(module_name)
    end
  end

  defp fetch_manifest(%{"name" => name, "version" => vsn}) do
    # Simulated registry fetch
    {:ok, %{"module" => name, "version" => vsn, "sig" => "valid"}}
  end
  defp fetch_manifest(_), do: {:error, :invalid_spec}

  defp verify_signature(%{"sig" => "valid"}), do: :ok
  defp verify_signature(_), do: {:error, :invalid_signature}

  defp extract_module(%{"module" => mod}) when is_binary(mod), do: {:ok, mod}
  defp extract_module(_), do: {:error, :no_module}

  defp register_module(module_name) do
    # Convert to atom - this creates new atoms from user-controlled plugin names
    mod_atom = String.to_atom("Elixir.CIRunner.Plugins." <> module_name)
    {:ok, mod_atom}
  end
end

defmodule CIRunner.AgentWorker do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(_) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{})
  end

  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  def handle_call({:run_stage, mod, args}, _from, state) do
    result = apply(mod, :run, [args, state])
    {:reply, {:ok, result}, state}
  rescue
    e -> {:reply, {:error, Exception.message(e)}, state}
  end
end
